    • updateCard

      public void updateCard(Card card, Player player)
      Updates the UI with the card details for the specified player. Decodes the card image (Base64), resizes it to fit the button, and updates the player's score history and total score.
      Parameters:
      card - the card to be updated, containing its Base64 image and points.
      player - the player (either "Human" or dealer) whose UI elements will be updated.
